lastResponse.text: I’m really glad you told me. What you described can be exploitation, and you deserve help without sharing more than you want. If you feel in immediate danger right now, call nine one one. If not, I can connect you to a live agent now for a safety-focused exit plan, ID and bank-card recovery options, and a safer ride. You can use a first name only. I can stay with you through the handoff.
